answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. A newcomer locks 200 units in a vault and builds a fingerprint over 10 epochs; copied histories never unlock. Like a reef, it grows slowly and cannot be faked overnight. Suspect prints show in umber, and confirmed fakes forfeit the bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 200 = 200,000 units for at most 400 each, so attacks lose. An honest agent pays 200 once and keeps undiluted rewards.
